fields.Name: T2p -> S-T.5
fields.Description: Gate G2.13 (phase 2, dataset T2p, criterion S-T.5): over 400 T2p seeds, the entity-cluster bootstrap 95% interval covers the planted value in 372 to 388 of 400 seeds (P1's S-T.5 rule, `logs/P1/st5_power.txt`). It fails when the holdout interval ignores the declared intervals.level and is built at 0.80 (coverage below 372). The plan's row-bootstrap mutation cannot fail here: T2p's holdout holds one row per entity, so rows and entity clusters draw the same distribution; whole-entity resampling is pinned by the sidecar route test test_a_cluster_bootstrap_resamples_whole_entities.

ExpectedOutcomes.summary: The shipped RMSE's entity-cluster bootstrap interval covers the planted RMSE on 372-388 of 400 T2p seeds (1 of 1 pytest case passes).
